attchmntText: Donear Industries Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication for Unaudited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results for quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Donear Industries Limited published newspaper advertisements for its unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The company is also subject to an e-auction sale notice for immovable properties by Central Bank of India under the Securitisation and Reconstruction of Financial Assets and Enforcement of Security Interest Act, 2002. The auction is scheduled for December 16, 2026, for recovery of dues from borrowers associated with Mhasrul Branch, Mahiravani Branch, and Goverdhan Branch. Sundaram Multi Pap Limited approved its unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the same period on November 13, 2026. Elevate Campuses Limited, formerly Good Host Spaces Limited, approved its financial results on November 12, 2026. Maharashtra Industrial Development Corporation extended the availability of blank e-tender documents for Tender Notice No. 37 of 2026 from November 13, 2026, to November 30, 2026. Jainx Education Limited issued a corrigendum to its Audited Standalone Financial Statements.

attchmntText: Donear Industries Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Donear Industries Limited approved its standalone and consolidated unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The Board also approved the incorporation of a wholly owned subsidiary named Donear Lifestyle Limited. The company will invest up to INR 5,00,000 towards the share capital of the new entity. The name was reserved by the Registrar of Companies on October 19, 2026. The subsidiary is intended to facilitate the company's business objectives in the textiles industry. The incorporation is expected to be completed within fifteen to twenty days. The Board meeting was held on November 13, 2026.
